competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times to decrease Defense for 2 turns with a 35% chance each.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times to deal damage proportionate to your Defense. Each hit disturbs HP recovery for 2 turns with a 40% chance and absorbs their Attack Bar by 10% with a 40% chance.

effets.description: The target's HP cannot be recovered.
Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself

competences.description: Goes under the Threat state while enemies attack with a single-target skill 2 times. Attacks all enemies to deal damage proportionate to your Defense, granting Silence for 2 turns and decreasing their Attack Bar by 50%.

effets.description: The enemy can only attack the target under the Threat state when using the attack skill. The duration of the Threat will be reduced only by skills that attack a single enemy target. The target under the Threat state will be inflicted with 15% less damage when attacked.
Skills with cooldowns will be locked. (Passive skills not included)
